source: NERC TPL-001-4 / IEEE C37.010 continuous thermal rating; any grid code
rationale: A line at or above its continuous rating in the base case. Removing any other line can only redistribute more flow onto it.

source: common TSO alert margin; not a stated numeric limit in the source standards
rationale: The classic pre-contingency alert margin. A line above 90% has under a tenth of its rating spare to absorb redistribution.

source: common TSO planning margin; not a stated numeric limit
rationale: A looser margin, included to test whether the family's value is in the threshold or in the variable.

source: ANSI C84.1 Range A lower bound; mirrored in most grid codes
rationale: Depressed voltage indicates a reactive-deficient area with little margin before collapse.

source: ANSI C84.1 Range A upper bound
rationale: Overvoltage indicates light loading or excess reactive support; the converse stress case.

source: ANSI C84.1 Range B / typical emergency band
rationale: The emergency band. A base case already outside it has no post-contingency margin.
Assessing N-1 security from a state that is already N-1 is really an N-2 assessment. The standard assumes an intact base case.
Two or more elements already out. The remaining network is materially weaker than the one the limits were set for.
Reactive-heavy flow on the critical line consumes thermal capacity without delivering power.

source: no stated numeric limit; 5% chosen as a round engineering figure before any measurement
rationale: A large generation/load gap implies heavy import or export across the network, which loads corridors.

source: conjunction of X_002 and a mild voltage depression
rationale: Thermal stress coinciding with voltage depression is the classic precursor to a cascading outage.

source: conjunction of a thermal margin and a degraded topology
rationale: A loaded network that has already lost an element has both less capacity and fewer paths.
System-wide reactive flow comparable to active flow indicates poor reactive support.

source: disjunction of a tight thermal margin and any outage
rationale: A deliberately permissive rule, included so the set is not uniformly conservative.
